description: Lists Swedish companies with open job ads for B2B salespeople (Företagssäljare) right now, from Platsbanken, Sweden's public job board (CC0). Recruitment and staffing agencies and mass hiring for door-to-door or telephone sales are removed. Optional filter by county (län). Use it to find companies that are building up their sales teams in Sweden.

county.description: Optional Swedish county, e.g. "Stockholm", "Skåne", "Västra Götaland". One of: Stockholm, Uppsala, Södermanland, Östergötland, Jönköping, Kronoberg, Kalmar, Blekinge, Skåne, Halland, Västra Götaland, Värmland, Örebro, Västmanland, Dalarna, Gävleborg, Västernorrland, Jämtland, Västerbotten, Norrbotten.

limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return.

name: find_companies_hiring_salespeople_sweden
title: Swedish companies hiring B2B salespeople
